sentences.text: Artzosuchus is a monospecific genus containing only the single species Artzosuchus brachicephalus.
The genus Artzosuchus was described by Efimov in 1983 based on fossils found at the Üüden Sair locality within the Djadochta Formation in Mongolia.
Artzosuchus belongs to the family Artzosuchidae.
However, its specific classification beyond being a basal crocodylomorph remains indeterminate due to the fragmentary nature of the fossil material.
This animal lived between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago during the Campanian stage of the Late Cretaceous period.
